records.title: Do Androids Dream of Breaking the Game? Systematically Auditing AI Agent Benchmarks with BenchJack
records.reason: BenchJack audits benchmark integrity for AI agents. The paper measures benchmark contamination/reward gaming, not inference systems or model-serving efficiency.

records.title: The Newton-Muon Optimizer
records.reason: Newton-Muon is an optimizer for parameter training. Its evaluations concern optimization/training behavior and do not establish inference-time compute, memory, or latency improvements.

records.title: Knowledge without Wisdom: Measuring Misalignment between LLMs and Intended Impact
records.reason: Knowledge without Wisdom measures alignment between model outputs and intended impact. Its benchmark/measurement contribution does not address inference performance.

records.title: Foundation Models in Smart Agriculture: Basics, Opportunities, and Challenges
records.reason: The smart-agriculture foundation-model survey covers applications and challenges, with a quantization connection, but the body is a broad domain survey and supplies no specific LLM inference optimization method or evaluated serving result.

records.title: LLaTTE: Scaling Laws for Multi-Stage Sequence Modeling in Large-Scale Ads Recommendation
records.reason: LLaTTE studies multi-stage sequence modeling in production ad recommendation; the sequence module accounts for >90% of upstream inference FLOPs and ~30% online ranking FLOPs. It is a concrete serving-budget analysis but proprietary recommendation architecture, not general LLM serving.
